use_case: Frontend asynchronous search state and race-condition repair
difficulty_rationale: Requires a complete async lifecycle: debouncing, stale response rejection, cancellation, errors, and disposal; verified with controlled scheduling.

provenance.rationale: Original compact harness fixture. Benchmark family references describe general methodology, not a copied upstream task.

human_summary: This task tests maintaining an interactive search feature when requests overlap and users change their selection. The developer must prevent stale results, handle cancellation and cleanup, and preserve keyboard navigation.
